title: 第五章 事不宜迟第六章 侵入
content_zh:
矿洞尽头的通道已经挖掘成了“t”形，因挖到了一具骨架的中段，然后顺着体态横卧的骨架左右开挖而导致，骨架的尾端已经全部挖了出来，目前的挖掘状态是在发掘头部。
根据骨架的体型规模来判断，以目前的挖掘速度，预估还要小半天的时间。
此时的挖掘动静已经暂停，一群人围堵在一块嗡嗡议论的声音，疾行而来的师春和吴斤两远远都能听到，两人穿行在骨架的两肋中间。
骨架很大很长，至今未发现脚爪之类的，看体型似乎是一种巨型蛇类，仅凭已经挖出的长度就有近三十丈。
骨架的颜色也有些奇怪，半黑半透，有种墨玉的感觉。
“还发光，到底什么东西？”
“要挖的不会就是这发光的东西吧？”
“你们说这玩意会不会很值钱？”
一高一矮两人跑到人群后面，听到纷纷议论声，见有的好奇交谈，有的嘀嘀咕咕咬耳朵，似乎有什么想法。
总之前面被看热闹的人堵死了，有人垫脚翘首，有人甚至像长臂猿似的跳起，吊在了上面骨架上看，反正就是堵的后来者难以看到前面的名堂。
师春当即一个个拍肩膀，“让一让，借过，让一让……”
有人让路，有人反应迟钝，有人磨磨蹭蹭还摊手，表示人挤人不好让，有些甚至上下打量他，一副大家都挤着凭什么给你让路的样子。
临时凑起的团伙，规矩方面确实不太尽如人意。
见一伙人如此反应，师春不惯他们毛病，手上鞭子直接抽了过去，呜呜抽打一通，打出一阵哎哟声或怪叫声，也有怒声斥责询问的，问凭什么打他们。
师春懒得回答，只想看清楚前面到底是怎么回事。
不关怎样，有时候暴力确实比客气管用，至少纷纷赶紧让路了，哪怕挤也要挤出一条路来让他通过。
这鞭子一出手，的确抽出了东九原是老子地盘的气魄。
跟在后面的吴斤两心弦略颤，可谓小汗一把，之前偷摸动手也就罢了，当众这样搞是不是太过了？
他发现这位大当家是真不把自己当外人呐，一点都不客气，一点贼人偷偷摸摸的觉悟都没有。
一开始决定要混进来的时候，他以为全程要躲躲闪闪个惊心动魄的，进来后却发现自己似乎想多了，感觉画风有点被大当家的给带歪了，眼前更是歪的有点离谱了。

拥挤在一块的人确实太多了，跟在大当家的后面也未能跟到最前，被前面排挤过来的人给重新堵住了，还好他个头够高，到了这个位置后，大概能看到前面是怎么回事了，稍一打量，两眼瞬间瞪大了！
师春自然是一路闯到了前面，站在前面的监工们听到后面的抽打动静，也就是回头看了看他，见是自己人，注意力又回到了斜上方。
看向上方的师春，眼睛也瞪大了几分，有难以置信的意味。
肋排龙骨似的骨架上，竟然又多出了一尊骨架，搁在龙骨上，没有完全发掘出来，虽是半埋土中，依然能从其半露的狰狞轮廓上看出是一只蛇头，也不知是不是这条龙骨的头颅。
是不是并不重要，重要的是蛇头上除了两处眼窝外，眉心处似乎还有一窝，不知是不是眼窝。
令所有人瞩目的是，那貌似第三只眼的凹骨眼窝内有一团虚浮的紫闪闪雾气，似无数细微紫闪闪星辰组成的小型星云一般，且内部不断幻变形态，时而像流云飘荡，时而像无数颗眼睛凝视，时而像数不清的魅蝶翩翩扇翅，煞是漂亮。
紫闪闪星云的规模差不多有一个人那么高大，因为蛇头骨上站了个人，正在星云旁尝试着伸手触摸，可作比照。
也确实好大的胆，都不知道这紫闪闪星云有没有害，就敢乱摸，不少人屏气凝神紧盯。
能看见的都知道，这星云绝对不简单，不知是个什么宝贝，这恐怕就是雇主开挖的主要目的了。
有人暗暗好奇，这雇主有够心大的，放着这样的奇珍，人居然敢不在现场盯着，这是笃定了没人能抢走吗？
蛇头骨两边还有人在兴奋挥镐破土，意图将整个蛇头骨给挖出来，土石不断哗啦啦掉落，好在地下这个深处的湿气重，没什么尘土。
那触摸星云的监工，手在星云里挥过来又挥过去，各种搅动，似乎不能给星云带来任何影响，口中还不时发出惊奇的“咦咦咦”声。
师春被他给“咦”的心痒痒，心里在问候他祖宗，咦个屁呀，怎么回事你倒是说出来呀。
后来实在是忍不住了，手上鞭子往腰上一别，就要蹦上去亲自上手试试。
谁知前排的一个监工突然出声喝道：“都下来，都不要挖了，你也不要再摸了，全部下来，等申先生来定夺。”
手在星云里挥动的监工，还有几个挥镐的矿工，当即都陆续跳了下来。
content_en:
The passage at the end of the mine has been dug into a "T" shape. This was caused by digging to the middle of a skeleton, and then digging along the left and right side of the lying skeleton. The tail end of the skeleton has been dug out, and the current excavation is still excavating the head.
Judging from the size of the skeleton, it is estimated that it will take less than half a day at the current excavation speed.
At this time, the excavation movement had been suspended. A group of people gathered around and the buzzing discussion could be heard from a distance by Shi Chun and Wu Jinliang, who were walking quickly and walked between the two ribs of the skeleton.
The skeleton is very large and long. No claws or the like have been found so far. Judging from the size, it seems to be a giant snake. The length that has been dug out alone is nearly thirty feet.
The color of the skeleton is also a bit strange, half black and half transparent, with a feeling of inky jade.
"It's still glowing, what is it?"
"Isn't this the glowing thing we want to dig up?"
"Do you think this thing is valuable?"
Two people, one tall and one short, ran to the back of the crowd and heard a lot of chatter. Some were talking curiously, and some were mumbling and biting their ears, as if they had some ideas.
In short, the front was blocked by onlookers. Some people put their feet up and raised their heads. Some even jumped up like gibbons and hung on the skeleton to look at it. Anyway, it was blocked and it was difficult for latecomers to see what was in front of them.
Shi Chun immediately patted his shoulders one by one and said, "Give way, borrow it, give way..."
Some people give way, some people are slow to react, and some people dawdle and spread their hands, indicating that it is difficult to give way to others in the crowd. Some even look at him up and down, as if there is no reason why he should give way to you when everyone is crowded.
The rules of this improvised gang are indeed not satisfactory.
Seeing a group of people reacting like this, Shi Chun was not used to their bad habits, so he lashed out with the whip in his hand, whining and slapping them, making a series of ouch or strange screams. Some of them scolded and asked angrily, asking why they were beaten.
Shi Chun was too lazy to answer, he just wanted to see clearly what was going on in front of him.
No matter what, sometimes violence is more effective than politeness. At least they quickly gave way, even if they were crowded, they had to squeeze out a way to let him pass.
Once this whip was used, it really took away the spirit that Dongjiu was originally my territory.
Wu Jinliang, who was following behind, had his heartstrings trembling slightly, and he was sweating a little. Before, he had just done it secretly, but was it too much to do it in public?
He found that the big boss really didn't regard him as an outsider, he was not polite at all, and he didn't have any awareness of being a thief.
When he first decided to sneak in, he thought he would have to dodge and dodge throughout the whole process in a thrilling way. However, when he came in, he found that he seemed to be thinking too much. He felt that his style of painting was a bit distorted by the boss, and the distortion in front of him was a bit ridiculous.
There were indeed too many people crowded together, and even the leader who was following behind could not reach the front. He was blocked again by the people in front of him. Fortunately, he was tall enough. When he reached this position, he could probably see what was going on in front of him. After taking a look, his eyes widened in an instant!
Naturally, Shi Chun rushed all the way to the front. The supervisors standing in front heard the sound of beatings from behind, so they turned around and looked at him. Seeing that it was one of their own, their attention returned to the diagonal upwards.
Looking up at Shi Chun, his eyes widened a bit in disbelief.
On the keel-like skeleton of the ribs, there is actually an extra skeleton. It is resting on the keel and has not been completely excavated. Although it is half buried in the soil, you can still tell from its half-exposed ferocious outline that it is a snake head. It is not known whether it is the head of this keel.
It doesn't matter whether it is. What is important is that in addition to the two eye sockets on the snake's head, there seems to be another one between the eyebrows. I don't know if it is an eye socket.
What caught everyone's attention was that there was a floating purple sparkling mist inside the concave eye socket that looked like the third eye, like a small nebula composed of countless tiny purple sparkling stars, and the interior was constantly changing shape, sometimes floating like drifting clouds.Sometimes it looks like countless eyes staring, sometimes it looks like countless butterfly wings fluttering, it is really beautiful.
The size of the Purple Sparkle Nebula is almost as tall as a person, because there is a person standing on the snake skull, trying to reach out and touch it for comparison.
He was indeed so bold. He didn't even know whether the purple sparkling nebula was harmful or not, yet he dared to touch it. Many people stared at it with bated breath.
Everyone who can see it knows that this nebula is definitely not simple. I don’t know what kind of treasure it is. This is probably the main purpose of the employer’s excavation.
Some people are secretly curious, this employer is so big-hearted that he dares not to keep an eye on such a rare treasure. Does this mean he is sure that no one can take it away?
There were people on both sides of the snake skull excitedly wielding pickaxes to break through the earth, intending to dig out the entire snake skull. The earth and rocks kept falling. Fortunately, the moisture deep underground was heavy and there was no dust.
The overseer who was touching the nebula waved his hand back and forth in the nebula. Various stirrings seemed to have no impact on the nebula, and he made surprised "Eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeing" sounds from his mouth from time to time.
Shi Chun was itching to feel "Eh" from him, and he was greeting his ancestors in his heart, "Eh, why don't you tell me what's going on."
Later, I couldn't bear it anymore. I put the whip on my waist and jumped up to try it myself.
Unexpectedly, a supervisor in the front row suddenly shouted: "Come down, stop digging, and stop touching. Come down and wait for Mr. Shen to make a decision."
The overseer, who was waving his hands in the nebula, and several miners wielding pickaxes, immediately jumped down one after another.
